name: Potamosia
account: A direct democracy. Decisions are made by a simple majority of all the citizens present. Two citizens chosen by lot chair each meeting: granting permission to speak, drafting resolutions and, calling votes. Mayors are elected officials with no formal authority over the council.

name: Hudrosia
account: An oligarchy. A council of the city’s elite decides, led by two hereditary kings, while the rest of the city looks on. In principle the council decides by consensus; in practice, by a majority in a secret council vote.
